name: Talonbranch Glade
summary: Night elves find a rare refuge at Talonbranch Glade in northern Felwood. South of Timbermaw Hold, the glade offers a moonwell, shelter, and hippogryph flights amid the blighted woods.

sections.title: A Beacon in the Blight
sections.body: Talonbranch Glade watches over the high ground near the tunnel to Timbermaw Hold. It is the Alliance’s northernmost bastion in Felwood, gathered around a sheltered night elf lodge and a working moonwell. Scouts, Sentinels, and travelers rest here before venturing deeper into the tainted woods or setting out for Winterspring and Moonglade.

sections.title: A Crossroads of the North
sections.body: Hippogryphs carry travelers from Talonbranch Glade to Auberdine in Darkshore and Everlook beyond Timbermaw Hold. The outpost keeps watch against the Shadow Council’s encroaching shadows and the feral beast packs roaming the corrupted vales.

faq.answer: Talonbranch Glade is an Alliance encampment in northern Felwood. Sentinels, druids, and travelers find refuge and rest there among the corrupted forest.

faq.q: Where does the flight master here fly to?
faq.answer: The hippogryphs at Talonbranch Glade fly to Auberdine, Everlook, and Moonglade.

faq.q: Is the water in the moonwell safe to drink?
faq.answer: Yes. Elune still blesses the moonwell at Talonbranch Glade, and demonic corruption has not touched it. Felwood’s pools and springs are tainted.

faq.q: How close is this to Timbermaw Hold?
faq.answer: Talonbranch Glade lies directly south of the entrance to Timbermaw Hold. It offers a final resting place before the furbolg tunnels lead into Winterspring or Moonglade.

angles.text: As an Alliance traveler, you can find your northernmost working outpost in Felwood at Talonbranch Glade. It offers flight connections, repairs, and sanctuary near Timbermaw Hold.
As a night elf, you can find an untouched moonwell at Talonbranch Glade. It is a sign of Elune’s enduring grace amid the demonic blight choking the ancient forest.
